hidden.value: The official plans page lists Better Browser as free. Better Answers is shown at $10/month on the plan cards and at $20/month in the FAQ on the same page. Better Days is $100/month. New users get a 14-day trial of Better Days.

It differentiates itself through live X integration and a single subscription that bundles Grok Chat, Imagine, Build, the Grok API, Cursor access and X benefits. Plans start with Plus at $8/month ($7/month billed annually); Premium is $30/month and higher Super and Ultra tiers add more usage. The plans page lists no $0 tier.

Box cannot reach myedit.io; web search + curl: official site is myedit.online (title 'MyEdit: Online AI Editor for Image, Video & Audio'); pricing page myedit.online/en/pricing via search: free tier with daily credits, paid from $5/month annually

Users can sign up for free; Pro costs $17/month billed annually and adds expanded Computer access, deep research and model selection, while Max costs $167/month billed annually with maximum usage and frontier models.
Comet has been free to download and use since October 2025; an optional Comet Plus subscription costs $5/month and is included with Perplexity Pro and Max.

A free trial of the core tools is available. The pricing page says yearly tiers are shown as an averaged monthly price: Starter $9.99/mo, Basic $16.99/mo, Pro $42.99, Ultimate $86.99/mo (Ultimate also lists $99.99).
